name: get_guide
description: Read this first. Workflow, timing rules for reading panels, camera style, sound and review loop for making a video with imgxplorer.

name: app_status
description: What imgxplorer has open: source (comic/folder), number of images, project file, video output size, current image, whether the project is read-only. loadMs: how long the current image took to show (missing while it is still loading).

name: open_source
description: Open a comic archive (cbz, cbr, cb7, zip, rar, 7z), a folder of images or a single image. Its animation project is loaded (or created) automatically.

name: create_comic
description: Create the user's own comic: a new folder (default Pictures/imgxplorer/<title>) with the chosen images COPIED in order and numbered (0001 - name.png…); the originals are never touched. Then it is opened. Use it when the user has loose images (generated with an AI, scanned…) instead of a folder or archive. With fromOpen: true it makes an ordered copy of the open comic (any folder or archive) together with its animation. Afterwards arrange_pages can reorder, add or remove pages.

title.description: Name of the comic (also the folder name).

images.description: Absolute paths of the images, in reading order.

sortByName.description: Sort the images by file name with numbers in natural order (2 before 10) instead of the given order.

fromOpen.description: Make the comic from the open source instead of images (its animation goes with it).

order.description: With fromOpen: image indexes of the open source in the new order (default all, as they are). Images left out are not copied.

dir.description: Folder where the comic folder is created (default the user's comics folder).

name: arrange_pages
description: Reorder, add or remove pages of the open comic. Only for the user's own comics (made with create_comic or the app's Create comic); for anything else use create_comic with fromOpen. Files are renamed so the order sticks; the animation, effects and bookmarks follow their pages; removed pages go to the comic's hidden .quitadas folder (not deleted). The comic is reopened: image indexes change, so call list_images again.

order.description: Every current image index that stays, in the new order (default: current order without the removed ones).

path.description: Absolute path of an image to copy in.

after.description: Current index of the image it goes after (-1 = at the start; default at the end).

add.description: Images from outside to copy into the comic.

remove.description: Current image indexes to take out of the comic.

name: list_images
description: Images of the open source in order, with their index (used by every other tool), name, and what animation and sound each one has.

name: go_to
description: Show an image in the app (so the user sees what you are working on).

name: view_image
description: Look at a whole page. Panels are drawn on top with their numbers in reading order (the same numbers plan_shots uses). Returns the image and the panel rectangles (normalized 0..1).

direction.description: Reading order: ltr (western) or rtl (manga). Default: the comic template's, else ltr.

name: view_panel
description: Look closely at one panel or any region at high resolution, to read its text and see its details before deciding the timing.

panel.description: Panel number as shown by view_image (1-based).

rect.description: Region instead of a panel (normalized 0..1 of the image).

name: get_panels
description: Panel rectangles of an image in reading order (normalized 0..1), and whether they were detected automatically or drawn by hand.

name: set_panels
description: Fix the panels of an image when detection is wrong (missing, merged or split panels). Order does not matter (reading order is computed). reset=true goes back to automatic detection.

name: set_output
description: Video format. Set it BEFORE planning shots: framing depends on the aspect ratio. Presets: 720p, 1080p, 1440p, 4k with shape landscape (16:9), portrait (9:16) or square; or exact width/height.

name: plan_shots
description: Animate an image as a list of camera shots (replaces its camera animation, keeps its sounds). For each shot say what to frame (a panel number, a region, or the whole page) and how long to stay; the app computes exact camera poses for the video aspect. Returns the start/hold/end time of every shot, used to place sounds.

rect.description: Region to frame instead of a panel (normalized). Use it for details, faces, a single balloon.

hold.description: Seconds staying on this shot (reading time).

move.description: Seconds to travel from the previous shot (default 0.8; 0 = hard cut).

margin.description: Air around the target, fraction per side (default 0.04).

zoom.description: Extra zoom on top of the exact framing (default 1; 1.3 = closer).

push.description: Slow zoom during the hold (default 1 = none; 1.05 = subtle push-in, 0.95 = pull-out).

start.description: overview: show the whole page first; direct: start on the first shot (default).

end.description: overview: go back to the whole page at the end; direct: stay on the last shot (default).

overviewHold.description: Seconds of whole page for start/end overview (default 1).

direction.description: Reading order used to number the panels (same as view_image).

name: get_timeline
description: Camera keyframes (absolute seconds), template, transition, sounds and visual special effects (fx, with their ids) of one image, and its duration.

name: set_keyframes
description: Low-level camera animation: exact keyframes. cx, cy = image point at the center of the video (normalized 0..1); zoom 1 = whole image fits; rot in degrees. The easing of a key applies to the segment that starts at it. Prefer plan_shots unless you need a special move.

name: apply_template
description: Use a ready-made animation template instead of hand-made shots: comic (panel by panel), scroll, bounce, ken-burns, full (still). For some images, or as the default for every image without its own animation. template 'none' removes it.

images.description: Image indexes. Omit to set the default for all images.

params.description: Template parameters, e.g. comic {dir: ltr|rtl, hold, move, margin, maxZoom, overview}, ken-burns {duration, zoom, focus, way}, full {duration}, scroll {dir, speed}.

name: set_transition
description: Transition from an image to the next: cut, fade, slide (with dir) or continuous-camera. Omit image to set the default for all.

name: set_hold_between
description: Pause in seconds at the end of every image before its transition (default 0.3).

name: get_adjust
description: Image adjustments (🎨) of an image: its own ones (or null), those for all images, and the ones it uses. Adjustments never change the file; they show in the viewer, render_frames and the exported video.

name: set_adjust
description: Set image adjustments for one image or (omit image) for all. Fields left out stay as they are; 'reset': true clears them first. Use 'clean' on yellowed/grey scans (whitens paper, deepens ink). Prefer subtle values (±0.1–0.3). Night mode is a reading setting, not part of the project.

image.description: Omit to set the adjustments for all images.

reset.description: Start from no adjustments (alone: remove them).

clean.description: Clean scan 0..1 (paper to white, ink to black).

name: list_sounds
description: Sounds in the app's sound library (built-in effects and ambiences, imported files, recorded voices) with their id, duration and whether they loop well as ambience.

name: find_audio_files
description: List audio files (mp3, wav, flac, ogg, m4a…) in a folder the user told you about, with their duration. Then import_sounds the ones you want.

name: import_sounds
description: Copy audio files into the sound library. Returns their sound ids.

name: list_tracks
description: Sound tracks of the project (shared by all images), grouped as voice, sfx and ambient, with volume, pan, mute and effects.

name: add_track
description: New sound track in a group, e.g. one voice track per character, or separate tracks for music and rain.

name: edit_track
description: Change a track: name, volume, pan, mute, effects (the effects list replaces the current one).

effects.description: Effect chain in order. See effects_catalog for types, presets and params.

name: add_audio
description: Place a sound on an image's timeline: a voice line (bus voice) or a sound effect (bus sfx). start is in seconds from the beginning of the image (use the shot times from plan_shots). If a voice is longer than the image's animation, the image lasts longer.

track.description: Track id (default: first track of the bus).

duration.description: Seconds to play (default: the rest of the sound).

trimIn.description: Skip this many seconds of the sound.

effects.description: Effects for this clip only (same format as edit_track: [{type, preset?, params?, on?}]).

name: edit_audio
description: Change a sound clip of an image (identified by image, bus and index as listed by get_timeline). Only the given fields change.

effects.description: Effects for this clip only (same format as edit_track: [{type, preset?, params?, on?}]).

name: remove_audio
description: Remove a sound clip from an image (bus and index from get_timeline).

name: add_ambient
description: Background sound or music that loops from one image to another (rain, city, soundtrack). It ducks under voices if the mix says so.

effects.description: Effects for this clip only (same format as edit_track: [{type, preset?, params?, on?}]).

name: edit_ambient
description: Change an ambience (id from summary or add_ambient). Only the given fields change.

effects.description: Effects for this clip only (same format as edit_track: [{type, preset?, params?, on?}]).

name: remove_ambient
description: Remove an ambience or music (id from summary). With image: stop it only on that image (on its first image it is removed everywhere; on a later one the range is shortened or split in two).

image.description: Optional: remove it only from this image (0-based).

name: set_mix
description: Group levels of the project mix: voice, sfx, ambient (0..2) and duck (lower ambience under voices).

name: effects_catalog
description: Audio effects available for tracks and clips: their parameters (range, default, unit) and presets (e.g. reverb cathedral, filter phone, pitch monster).

name: fx_catalog
description: Visual special effects that can be placed on an image's timeline (shake, zoom punch, flash, shockwave, chromatic/glitch, radial blur, manga focus lines and speed lines, impact frame, color, vignette, wave): their parameters (range, default, unit), presets, and ready-made situations (explosion, punch, lightning, surprise, flashback…) that combine several effects and an optional built-in sound.

name: add_fx
description: Add a visual special effect, or a ready-made situation (several synced effects plus its sound), to an image. Place it at start seconds from the beginning of the image, or at a shot from plan_shots (shot: 1-based, offset: seconds after the shot arrives). Use them only where the panel calls for it (an explosion, a hit, a surprise…) and review with render_frames.

situation.description: Ready-made situation id from fx_catalog (e.g. explosion, punch, surprise, flashback). Use this or type.

type.description: Single effect type from fx_catalog (e.g. shake, flash, shockwave, focus-lines). Two are text: text (animated onomatopoeia like BOOM!, stuck to its point) and caption (subtitle, title or narration box fixed on screen; also exported as .srt).

start.description: Seconds from the start of the image.

shot.description: Shot number (1-based) as returned by plan_shots (the opening overview of the page is not counted); the effect starts when the camera arrives and holds there.

duration.description: Seconds (single effect only; default from the preset).

params.description: Parameter values for a single effect, e.g. {"strength": 3}. For text: {"text": "¡ZAS!", "color": "#ffd400", "anim": "shake"}; for caption: {"text": "Line of dialogue", "style": "subtitle"}.

at.description: Point of the image (normalized 0..1) where it happens: center of a shockwave, focus lines or blur. Omit for the center of the screen.

sound.description: For a situation: also add its built-in sound on the sfx bus (default true).

text.description: For a situation: also add its onomatopoeia (BOOM!, POW!…) if it has one (default false).

name: edit_fx
description: Change a visual effect of an image (id from get_timeline or add_fx): start, duration, intensity, preset, parameters (merged; null removes one), its point (at) or back to the center of the screen (resetPoint).

at.description: Normalized image point {x, y} where it happens.

resetPoint.description: true: the effect happens at the center of the screen again.

name: remove_fx
description: Remove a visual effect from an image (id from get_timeline). Its sound clip, if a situation added one, stays: remove it with remove_audio.

name: cast_get
description: AI voices: the cast (characters with their voice description and assigned voice), the provider and whether it is ready (key saved). Read this before creating characters so each one is created only once.

name: cast_set
description: AI voices: add or change characters (matched by id or by name), or remove them with remove:true. The description is the voice prompt: age, personality, accent, tone, way of speaking (20-1000 characters), e.g. 'veteran warrior about 50, deep husky voice, speaks slowly'. voice assigns an existing voice from voice_list (id or name); null removes it.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the lines (es, en, ja…).

voice.description: Voice id or name from voice_list.

name: voice_list
description: AI voices: the voices in the user's ElevenLabs account (premade, designed, cloned), to assign one with cast_set instead of designing a new one.

name: voice_design
description: AI voices: create a new voice for a character from its description (ElevenLabs Voice Design) and assign it. The app shows the user the request and waits for Accept (it sends the description to ElevenLabs). Makes 3 samples and keeps sample `pick`. You cannot hear it: ask the user to try it.

description.description: Optional: replace the character's description first.

pick.description: Which of the 3 samples to keep (1-3, default 1).

name: script_get
description: AI voices: the script of an image (each line with character, kind, text, start, status draft/generated/stale and its clip).

name: script_set
description: AI voices: write the script of an image, in reading order. Each line: character (id or name; not needed for narration or crowd), text with performance tags in brackets ([whispers], [shouting], [laughs], [sighs]…; only with eleven_v3/v4), kind (dialogue, thought, narration, crowd) and when it starts: start (seconds) or shot (1-based, from plan_shots) + offset. With replace:false, lines are added or updated by id instead of replacing the whole script. Changing a generated line marks it stale (regenerate it). Nothing is generated or spent here.

name: voices_estimate
description: AI voices: what generating would cost, without sending anything: fragments, new characters, already generated (free, from the cache), approximate USD and the session usage/limit. Lines not up to date by default; all:true for every line.

name: voices_generate
description: AI voices: generate the script lines (not up to date ones, or `lines` ids, or all:true) of one or several images and place them as clips on the voice track (crowd lines on the effects track). SPENDS CREDITS: the app shows the user the exact order and waits for Accept (unless it fits the budget the user approved in settings); if they cancel you get an error. Lines already generated with the same text and voice come free from the cache. Clips keep their place and effects when regenerated.

lines.description: Line ids (default: lines not up to date).

name: sfx_generate
description: AI sound effect or background (crowds, battle cries, a specific creature…) from a description, 0.5-30 s, saved to the sound library. SPENDS CREDITS after the user accepts. Try the library first (list_sounds). With image (+ start or shot/offset) it is also placed on that image's effects track; otherwise use add_audio / add_ambient with the returned id.

name: music_generate
description: AI music from a prompt (genre, mood, instruments, tempo), 3-600 s, saved to the sound library. SPENDS CREDITS after the user accepts: keep it to the moments that need it and try the library first. Then use add_ambient with the returned id to play it across images.

name: summary
description: Overview of the project: every image with its animation, duration, shots, sounds, visual effects and warnings (too short to read, image without animation, missing sound, flashes too close together…), ambiences, tracks and total video length.

name: render_frames
description: Review an image's animation: a contact sheet of video frames exactly as they will be exported (visual effects included), each labeled with its time. By default one frame per shot (middle of each hold) plus the peak of each visual effect; or give times.

times.description: Seconds from the start of the image.

count.description: Evenly spaced frames instead of one per shot.

name: sound_report
description: Measure the real mix (same as the export) of a range of images: peak and average level, seconds where the limiter works, silences, loudest moments, overlapping voices and clips longer than their image. You cannot hear; use this and ask the user to listen with play.

name: play
description: Play the animation with sound in the app from an image, for the user to watch and listen. stop=true stops it.

name: export_video
description: Export the video (runs in the background; poll export_status): MP4 by default, or WebM / GIF. Uses the size and fps from set_output. Default path: next to the comic. Does not overwrite an existing file unless overwrite=true. If the images have captions, a .srt with them is saved next to the video.

format.description: mp4 (H.264 + AAC, default), webm (VP9 + Opus) or gif (no sound, at most 15 fps: keep it short and small).

srt.description: Also save the captions as .srt next to the video (default true; only if there are captions).

name: export_story
description: Save the open comic as a shareable .imgxstory story (runs in the background; poll export_status): one file with the pages, the animation, effects, texts and every sound and voice it uses. Whoever receives it opens it in imgxplorer (open_source) to watch or edit it. variant 'desktop' keeps the original page quality; 'mobile' shrinks pages to 2560 px at most (same format, much smaller). No ffmpeg needed. Does not overwrite an existing file unless overwrite=true.

path.description: Output path (.imgxstory). Default: next to the comic.

variant.description: desktop (original quality, default) or mobile (smaller pages).

title.description: Title shown when it is opened (default: the comic's name).

credits.description: Optional free text: who made it, voices, music… Ask the user; never invent names.

keepTakes.description: Also include previous voice takes (default false: only the take that plays).

name: export_status
description: Progress of the export: running (fraction 0..1), done (with the file path), error or cancelled.

name: cancel_export
description: Stop the running export and delete the partial file.

name: inspect_video
description: Check an exported MP4: duration, size, streams, sound level, and frames taken from the file itself at the given times (or evenly spaced).

count.description: Evenly spaced frames if no times (default 6, max 16).

name: undo
description: Undo the last change(s) to the project (yours or the user's).

name: redo
description: Redo project changes undone with undo.
